description: Invoices whose total equals 3.98 are included in the average.

d.request: The average of `Invoice.Total` over invoices whose total is greater than or equal to 3.98 (so invoices with a total of exactly 3.98 are included), ignoring null totals, as a single unrounded value, or null if no invoices qualify.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98

b.request: The average of `Invoice.Total` over invoices whose total is greater than or equal to 3.98 (so invoices equal to 3.98 are included), ignoring null totals, returned unrounded, or null if no invoices qualify.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98
b.raw: The average of `Invoice.Total` over invoices whose total is greater than or equal to 3.98 (so invoices equal to 3.98 are included), ignoring null totals, returned unrounded, or null if no invoices qualify.

a.request: What is the average invoice total (`Invoice.Total`) over all invoices whose total is at least 3.98, as a single unrounded value? Ignore missing totals, and give a missing result if no invoices qualify.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98

c.request: Using 3.98 as the cutoff on the invoice total (`Invoice.Total`) to keep only the higher-value invoices, what is their average total, as a single unrounded value? Ignore missing totals, and give a missing result if no invoices qualify. Invoices whose total equals 3.98 are included in the average.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS avg_total FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98 AND Total IS NOT NULL
